newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures close sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures close sharply higher.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures surged on Monday due to position adjustment for the spot January contract expiry this Friday and the yen's falls against the dollar, traders said.

The limitless spot January closed up 580 yen at 15,880 yen per tonne. Others were 220 to 390 yen higher, with the benchmark November 1997 contract up 220 yen at 13,800 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 61,568 lots.
Active buying by individual investors emerged from the opening, as the yen's drops against the dollar turned market sentiment bullish, traders said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.67 per bushel at 0825 GMT, against $2.67-1/4 at Friday's close.
The spot January contract of CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $6.96 per bushel at 0825 GMT, steady from Friday's close.
